newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria reshuffles cabinet, new finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Algeria reshuffles cabinet, new finance minister.

text.p: Algeria reshuffled its cabinet on Thursday, naming new trade, finance and industry ministers, state-run radio said.
The presidential statement read on radio said trade minister Abdelkrim Harchaoui was moved to head the finance ministry in the place of Ahmed Benbitour.
The statement said the new trade minister would be Bakhti Belaid, a major force in President Liamine Zeroual's campaign last November in Algeria's first multi-party presidential elections.
Industry Minister Mourad Benachenou was replaced by Abdessalam Bouchouareb, head of government-appointed Economic and Social National Council.

The statement said the reshuffle was made on the recommendation of Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia. The changes come a week after the government announced a mixed economic performance marked by a continuing fall in the industrial sector outside of gas and oil.
The government said this week it was time to speed up restructuring and privatisation of industry outside oil and gas.
